v33_world.description: CYC4-006. Starts a session in the current world. Expect SESSION_START session=v33_world. After the owner reopens the same world: WORLD sameAsSession=true and the session still active. After the owner opens another world: SESSION_STOP reason=worldChanged first, then WORLD sameAsSession=false with no session field.

v33_check.description: CYC4-006. Run after a world switch. Its MARK carries the session name only if the session survived.
